_comment: THIS IS THE ONLY FILE YOU EDIT FOR A NEW WEBSITE. Everything else stays identical. Configured for indianfoods.co.in.

company.name: Indian Foods
company.what_we_are: recipe blog publishing authentic Indian home cooking, with tested recipes and original food photography
company.services: traditional recipes, street food and chaat, snacks and pakoras, Indian breads, sweets and desserts, curries and sabzis, rice and biryani, vegan and healthy dishes, festival and seasonal recipes, drinks
company.audience: home cooks in India and the Indian diaspora worldwide, from beginners to confident cooks
company.reading_level: a home cook who wants a clear, reliable recipe with no jargon
company.author_bio: Indian Foods is a recipe blog by Shashi, a food writer and photographer who shares authentic Indian home cooking, seasonal dishes, and the stories behind them.
company.trusted_sources: FSSAI, ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition (NIN), USDA FoodData Central, or an established recipe authority / .gov / .edu source relevant to the topic
company.facts_to_respect: Indian Foods focuses on vegetarian and vegan home cooking; keep recipes and examples vegetarian unless the topic is explicitly non-veg. Respect real Indian cooking technique and terminology (tadka/tempering, soaking times for dal and rice, resting dough, the difference between besan and maida, roasting vs frying spices). NEVER present any dish or ingredient as curing, preventing, or treating a medical condition. NEVER invent calorie counts, macros, nutrition figures, or health statistics -- describe benefits qualitatively ("a good source of protein") rather than with numbers. Do not repeat unverified marketing or health claims.

banned_phrases: at the end of the day
